paragraph: Upper Saddle River is a single-family market, plainly. Fifty-four sales over six months at a median of $1,688,750, with a range from $825,000 up to $5,325,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. The typical sale is a five-bedroom colonial with three or four baths, and ranches make up a real share of the rest. The sale-to-list ratio landed at 1.00 with 48 percent of homes going above asking and a median of 17.5 days on market. Competitive but not frenzied, and well-priced homes are moving quickly. Volume climbed into June as you would expect, and the softer May and June medians came on that rising volume, which reads as a shift toward the lower end of the price range rather than falling values. July came back up at $1,950,000 on nine sales. Condos and townhouses barely register here, two closings in six months, so if you want low maintenance in this town you will be waiting on inventory rather than choosing from it.
